key_concepts: Mixtures are combinations of two or more substances
Mixtures can be homogeneous or heterogeneous
Homogeneous mixtures appear uniform all throughout
Homogeneous mixtures have the same proportion of components
Heterogeneous mixtures are not uniform in proportion
In heterogeneous mixtures, combined substances are not evenly spread or mixed
Components of heterogeneous mixtures are often visible or easily identified
Air, alcohol, and tea with sugar are examples of homogeneous mixtures
Pizza, vegetable salad, and pinakbet are examples of heterogeneous mixtures
Some mixtures, like 3 in 1 coffee, can become homogeneous when dissolved in hot water
